name: Web Tools
description: Agent tools on top of the promoted web built-ins: web_download saves a URL to disk, web_research distills and summarizes URLs into a cited answer. (web_search / web_fetch themselves are host built-ins.)
author: cognia-next

networkAccess.reasoning: web_download and web_research operate on URLs the user or agent supplies at runtime, so any host may be reached. Page reads go through the promoted host web_fetch, so the Settings kill switch, SSRF guard, rate limiter and PII gate still apply.

userAgent.title: User-Agent override
userAgent.description: Optional User-Agent header sent with the page reads web_research makes through web_fetch.

downloadDirectory.title: Download subfolder
downloadDirectory.description: Optional relative subfolder inside this plugin's data directory that web_download writes into on desktop (e.g. "reports"). Leave empty for the data root.

mobile.reason: web_download cannot persist files from the mobile WebView (no download manager); web_research still works.

en.manifest.name: Web Tools

zh-CN.manifest.name: 网页工具
zh-CN.manifest.description: 基于内置网页能力的 Agent 工具：web_download 把网址保存到磁盘，web_research 提炼并总结多个网址，给出附引用的答案。（web_search / web_fetch 本身是宿主内置工具。）
